beats.say: Hello! Today we look at job offers that promise easy money from home.
The task is simple: like, review, send a screenshot. And the pay is suspiciously high.

body.text: Hello! Work from home: like products and write reviews.

beats.say: They really do pay the first five manat. It is bait for a big payment later.
The rule: if you must pay to start or to withdraw earnings, it is a scam.

scenes.title: Work from home
scenes.intro: A job offer arrives from an unknown number. Choose your reply to each message.

body.text: Hello! We got your number from your profile on a job site.
Work from home: 1-2 hours a day, 40-120 AZN. Interested?

actions.label: Yes, tell me more
actions.feedback: Showing interest is not a loss yet, but this chat leads to a payment. Watch every step.

actions.label: Block and report
actions.feedback: Right. An unexpected offer with sky high pay is warning enough.

body.text: First task: give these 3 products 5 stars and send a screenshot.

actions.label: Doing it, sending the screenshot
actions.feedback: Fake reviews mislead other buyers. It is also the first rung of the scam.

actions.label: No fake reviews, I block them
actions.feedback: Right. Being paid to like and review is a well known sign of this scam.

steps.label: 10:03 SahilBank

messages.text: Incoming to your card: 5.10 AZN. Balance: 63.40 AZN.

steps.say: Money really did arrive on your card.

actions.label: Money came, so the job is real
actions.feedback: A small payout is there to win your trust. The scammer takes back many times more later.

actions.label: It is bait. I stop here
actions.feedback: Right. The first payout is bait, the next step is asking you for money.

body.text: VIP task: deposit 50 AZN, get 130 AZN back in 30 minutes.
Everyone in the group earns, look, 47 people got paid today.

steps.say: Now they moved you to a Telegram group.

actions.label: I deposit 50 AZN
actions.feedback: That money will not come back. The winners in the group are the scammers themselves.

actions.label: Leave and report the group
actions.feedback: Right. If you must deposit money to work, it is not a job but a scam.

body.text: System error: your balance is now -86 AZN.
Pay 86 AZN or your 214 AZN earnings will be deleted.

steps.say: After you paid, the balance suddenly went negative.

actions.label: I pay the 86 AZN too
actions.feedback: There will be a new reason after every payment. Stop and report it to your bank and the police on 102.

actions.label: I do not pay, I block and report
actions.feedback: Right, paying to release earnings is the last rung of the scam. Keep the chat as evidence.

steps.label: IshBazar: new vacancy

body.text: Interview at the office, salary 850 AZN. Apply on the site.

steps.say: And this is a real vacancy.

actions.label: View the vacancy
actions.feedback: Right. A real vacancy names the company, has an interview and a real salary, and never asks you to pay.

actions.label: Look later
actions.feedback: That is fine. A real job ad does not vanish, you can check it calmly.

nodes.text: I put 120 manat into the tasks. Now they want a 15 percent tax to withdraw. Should I pay?
nodes.speaker: Leyla, your relative (on the phone)
nodes.spoken: I put 120 manat into the tasks. <breath> Now they want a 15 percent tax to withdraw. Should I pay?

choices.label: Don't pay, it is the same scam going on
choices.feedback: Right. A tax or fee to withdraw earnings is a sign of fraud.

choices.label: Pay, or the 120 manat is lost too
choices.feedback: That only grows the loss. After the tax there will be a new excuse.

nodes.text: I also sent them a photo of my ID card to register. Is that a problem?
nodes.speaker: Leyla
nodes.spoken: I also sent them a photo of my ID card to register. <breath> Is that a problem?

choices.label: Yes, let's tell the bank and the police about it too
choices.feedback: Right. An ID photo can be used to open accounts or loans in your name.

choices.label: No, a photo is useless to them
choices.feedback: On the contrary, an ID photo can be used to open fake accounts in her name. Report that too.

nodes.text: So what do I do now?
nodes.speaker: Leyla
nodes.spoken: <breath> So what do I do now?

choices.label: Call your bank, report to the police on 102, keep the chat
choices.feedback: Great. The bank may try to stop the transfer, and the chat is evidence for the police.

choices.label: Delete everything and forget it
choices.feedback: Deleting the chat destroys the evidence. There is no shame in it, just report it.

choices.label: Write to the channel that promises to get money back
choices.feedback: Those who promise to recover money are often the same scammers. Do not pay them anything.

scenes.prompt: Match the phrase in the offer with what it really means.

pairs.right: Bait: real work does not pay like this

pairs.left: Everyone in the group is earning

scenes.explain: Whatever the payment is called, if you pay to work, it is not a job.

points: A job paying you to like and review is a scam.
The first small payout is bait; deposits and withdrawal taxes are the trap.
Already paid? Bank, police 102, keep the chat.
